security_updates.label: Security and updates
security_updates.description: Find out-of-date apps, Python and Node packages, drivers, firmware and system software, and update what you approve.

storage_cleanup.label: Storage and cleanup
storage_cleanup.description: See what fills your drive; delete files for good, set them aside (can be undone; frees no space) or back them up first (may need extra space).

diagnosis_repair.label: Diagnosis and repair
diagnosis_repair.description: Find out why something goes wrong and fix what I can: update an app, reinstall the same version (Mac, Linux) or finish a cut-off software install (Debian, Ubuntu).

backup_recovery.label: Backup and recovery
backup_recovery.description: Make a checked copy of files you choose, or bring them back.
